The page doesn't actually cover a solar panel combo, despite the title you mentioned. It's a deal page for the power station alone, and it doesn't name or link any panels.

**ALLPOWERS R4000: 3,456 Wh, 3,600 W**
- **Price:** $1,499 at the store (list $3,299).
- **Best code:** EXTRA12 takes $179.88 off, bringing it to **$1,319.12**. It's 12% off orders over $1,200 and expires 2026-11-15.
- **Other codes:** ALLPOWERS26 and EXTRA10 each give $149.90 off, for $1,349.10. The store usually accepts one code per order, so EXTRA12 is the one to use.
- **Buy link:** [ALLPOWERS R4000 via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-r4000-3456wh). It's an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Check the final price at checkout.

**Specs that matter for an RV**
- **Battery:** LiFePO4, rated for 3,500+ cycles, with a 5-year warranty.
- **AC output:** 3,600 W continuous at 120 V, 6,000 W peak, and it has a dedicated RV outlet. The "4,000 W" in the title is the 230 V rating, so it doesn't apply in the US.
- **Solar input:** up to 2,000 W across 3 XT60 inputs. Each input takes 12–60 V and tops out at 650 W, so you need panels on all three inputs to reach 2,000 W.
- **AC recharge:** about 2 hours from a wall outlet.
- **Weight:** 45 kg (about 99 lb), so it isn't something you carry by hand. It's better as a fixed or semi-fixed unit in the RV.
- **Returns:** 30 days for unused items, and you pay return shipping unless the unit is defective. The store's refund page also says sale items can't be returned, so check whether this price counts as a sale item.

**Before you buy**
- Work out your daily power use. 3.4 kWh covers a fridge, lights, and electronics for a day or two, but not air conditioning for long.
- Check that the RV outlet matches your rig's plug and amperage. The page doesn't give those details.
- For solar, pick panels whose voltage and wattage fit within 12–60 V and 650 W per input. Roughly 400–600 W of panels on one input is a common starting point. Add more inputs if you want faster recharging.

If you'd like, I can look up compatible solar panels, such as rigid roof-mount or portable folding ones, and compare prices.
